intent: Improve three existing Esteban local buyer routes with answer-first service-specific published portfolio proof, factual inquiry guidance, internal links, and owner-confirmed South Florida coverage from Palm Beach through the Keys; no fictional offices or unsupported offers.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: Existing buyer routes must retain compact reading and visible published proof while adding one factual service-area decision.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: Esteban covers all South Florida from Palm Beach through the Keys; the client pays transportation when the location is far.
visual_evidence.comparison: current production versus 390x844 and 1440x900 build output

brief.promise: See real published work, understand coverage, and know what a scoped inquiry needs.
brief.primary_action: Send a project inquiry with the location, goal, schedule and existing footage.
brief.friction: The previous coverage copy held Palm Beach as expansion-only and did not state the owner-confirmed full South Florida service boundary.

kpi.event: contact intent from a changed route
kpi.evidence: Attributable contact instrumentation exists; no post-change outcome exists yet.

concept.visible_response: Coverage, transport condition and proof links are present in server-rendered HTML.

story.consequence: Send the project facts needed for a quote

content.visible: Coverage wording, published proof, FAQs and inquiry guidance.
content.linked_depth: Existing area page, portfolio and service routes.
